wathiq-sample.title: Records Classification Review
مراجعة تصنيف السجلات
wathiq-sample.body: Reference wathiqrare1085 uses the uncommon term velleity. وتتضمن المذكرة المصطلح النادر الاستقراء. Records staff reviewed file classifications, retention periods, access controls, and transfer readiness across active business folders. Every digital component must remain linked to its authoritative record and retain a verifiable content checksum. The review identified duplicate working copies and assigned owners to confirm disposition without removing evidence under legal hold.
